data.name: Lazariah
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Lazariah means 'God is my help'. This name has a rich history in the Bible, where it is given to several prominent figures including a Levite priest and a grandson of King Jehoiakim of Judah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who trust in God's help and support.

in_hebrew.name: לזariah
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם לזariah מקורו במילה העברית 'לזר' שפירושה 'אלוהים עזר' או 'ה' עזר'. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'לזר' ו'אל' או 'יה', שפירושם 'אלוהים' או 'ה'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד, ומשמעותו הרעיונית היא עזרה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Λαζαρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λαζαρία προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'לזר' (Lazar) που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός βοηθά'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Λάζαρος ήταν ο φίλος του Ιησού, τον οποίο ανέστησε από τους νεκρούς. Το όνομα αυτό έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και συμβολίζει τη βοήθεια του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Lazariah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lazariah originem habet in voce hebraea 'Lazar', quae significat 'Deus adiutor'. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc refertur ad Lazarum, amicum Iesu, quem a mortuis suscitavit. Significatio nominis est auxilium Dei, quod est fundamentum spiritualitatis christianae.

in_english.name: Lazariah
in_english.meaning: God helps or assisted by God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lazariah originates from the Hebrew word 'Lazar', meaning 'God helps' or 'assisted by God'. It is derived from the biblical figure Lazarus, a close friend of Jesus, whom he raised from the dead. The name Lazariah symbolizes divine assistance and has been used in Christian tradition to signify spiritual help and guidance. It reflects the values of faith and reliance on God's providence.

biblical_reference.note: The name Lazariah is associated with Lazarus, the brother of Martha and Mary, whom Jesus raised from the dead.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lazariah becomes culturally significant as it is a reminder of the religious and historical roots of the Jewish and Christian faiths. It emphasizes the importance of seeking help and support from God during times of need, which is a common theme in both religious traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Lazariah represents depending on God for strength, guidance, and protection throughout one's journey in life. He is best known for his role in the monastic revival in Syria during the late Antiquity. Lazarius is believed to have founded numerous monasteries and to have written several important works on monastic life.

Lazarus of Bethany, also known as Lazariah of Bethany, was a friend of Jesus and a prominent figure in the New Testament. He is most famously remembered for having been raised from the dead by Jesus. The name Lazariah is believed to be derived from the Greek word lázaros, meaning 'help', 'assistance', or 'God is my help'.
